nodes.title: OpenSSH interoperability is cohort- and candidate-bound

source.quote: Two cohorts' results are never combined, averaged, subtracted or carried forward into one another's verdicts

nodes.statement: An OpenSSH result names its version, tarball digest and candidate; two cohorts are never combined, averaged or carried forward.

nodes.title: A consumer closure classifies every reachable edge

source.quote: every omitted edge needs an independently checkable exclusion argument; no aggregation hiding a blocked row

nodes.statement: Every reachable edge is classified; an omitted edge needs an independently checkable exclusion, and no aggregation hides a blocked row.

nodes.title: A claim never exceeds its evidence

source.quote: a claim may never exceed its evidence; an implementation is not a specification

nodes.statement: An implementation is not a specification, a test is not a proof, and a summary never stands in for the evidence it summarises.

nodes.title: An instrument demonstrates sensitivity before it is cited

source.quote: an instrument must demonstrate sensitivity to the defect it claims to detect

nodes.statement: An instrument is admitted with a paired control that fires on the defect class it claims to detect, and its soundness limits are stated.

nodes.title: Evidence is bound to its exact identity and is never fresh by assumption

source.quote: historical evidence is never fresh evidence

nodes.statement: Historical evidence is never fresh evidence; a candidate change invalidates rather than transfers the result.

nodes.title: Claim axes are orthogonal

source.quote: a property does not imply a modality; a modality does not imply a verdict

nodes.statement: No claim axis implies another: verdict, modality, identity and evidence support are independent, and no scalar score combines them.

nodes.title: Graduation requires the whole dependency closure

source.quote: A family graduates only when every applicable mechanism ... is SAFETY_DISCHARGED

nodes.statement: A consumer family is SAFE_COMPATIBLE only when every applicable mechanism in its closure is SAFETY_DISCHARGED and compatibility is confirmed at the exact implementation.

nodes.title: Ownership adoption discharges a provenance contract

source.quote: An ownership-adoption constructor ... MUST be unsafe fn with a # Safety contract.

nodes.statement: An ownership-adoption constructor is unsafe, states provenance, extent, alignment, initialisation, exclusive ownership and the exact release mechanism, and no safe function can cause an invalid free.

nodes.title: Allocated storage and initialised values are separate states

source.quote: Allocated storage and initialized Rust values are separate states.

nodes.statement: No reference, initialised read or full destructor is permitted before the type's validity invariants hold; partially initialised objects release only what they acquired.

nodes.title: Allocation arithmetic is fallible and checked

source.quote: MUST use checked_mul/checked_add and translate overflow to the OpenSSL failure semantics

nodes.statement: Counts, sizes, sums and offsets used for allocation are checked; overflow becomes the failure semantics, not a panic.

nodes.title: Omission is detectable against a pre-registered population

source.quote: a producer cannot PASS by omitting a failed result

nodes.statement: A producer cannot pass by omitting a failed result; the expected evidence population is frozen before execution and reconciled afterwards.

nodes.title: A panic across the C ABI leaves a defined state

source.quote: For stateful contexts require one of: failure-atomic mutation, explicit rollback, or a poisoned state

nodes.statement: A caught panic does not leave partially mutated state usable: the operation is failure-atomic, rolled back or explicitly poisoned.

nodes.title: Performance classifications are disjoint from assurance

source.quote: These are performance classifications and are disjoint from SAFE_COMPATIBLE

nodes.statement: MEASURED, AHEAD and FRONTIER_LEADING are performance classifications and never imply SAFE_COMPATIBLE or semantic assurance.

nodes.title: A virtualised venue yields only SCOPED_OBSERVATION

source.quote: Until that venue exists, results are labelled SCOPED_OBSERVATION with the venue named.

nodes.statement: A result measured without bare metal and a PMU is labelled SCOPED_OBSERVATION with its venue and is not a frontier result.

nodes.title: Independent builds are byte-identical

source.quote: two independently initialised clean builds; ... no byte-normalisation to manufacture a PASS

nodes.statement: Two independently initialised clean builds produce byte-identical artefacts, and a reproducible build is not thereby a correct build.

nodes.title: Secret-bearing storage is cleansed on every exit path

source.quote: Cleansing must cover the actual secret-bearing storage, including ... failure paths.

nodes.statement: Cleansing covers the actual secret-bearing storage, including copies, temporaries, partially initialised states and failure paths; release and cleansing are separate.

nodes.title: Secret-dependent operations preserve constant-time discipline

source.quote: never introduce secret-dependent branches or early exits

nodes.statement: Secret-dependent operations have no secret-dependent branch, address or early exit, and the intent is preserved under optimisation and checked at the exact artefact.

nodes.title: Specifications are independent of the implementation

source.quote: Specifications and security requirements are never generated by restating the production implementation.

nodes.statement: Specifications and security requirements are never generated by restating the production implementation; one independent hierarchy exists.

nodes.title: Secret-bearing arithmetic fails rather than aborting

source.quote: Infallible allocations in limbs::rem/limbs::mul; ... still plain Vecs (OBL-BN-ALLOCATOR)

nodes.statement: Allocation on the secret-bearing path is fallible and returns an error on exhaustion; no unchecked allocation remains on that path.

nodes.title: Exponentiation, inversion and division are fixed-pattern at public geometry

source.quote: BN_div ignores BN_FLG_CONSTTIME ... it is a variable-time path on secret operands

nodes.statement: Modular exponentiation, inversion and division on secret operands use a fixed pattern whose loop count and storage width follow public geometry, with the residual channels stated.
